svg.text: A WebFlux sample for S3 auto-configuration, coroutine object APIs, presigned URLs, and optional client-side encryption.

g.text: Encrypted routes require an available S3ClientSideEncryptionOperations bean.
ApplicationContextRunner supplies emulator endpoint, credentials, and KMS stub.

svg.text: Use this example to copy S3 auto-configuration into WebFlux routes, including optional tenant-aware encrypted objects.
